# Clinekt Health

> Clinekt Health (clinekthealth.com) is the AI patient activation platform for specialty medical practices. Four AI agents, sharing one memory of every patient (Clinekt OS), cover the whole patient journey: the Inbound Agent converts website visitors into booked patients 24/7, the Recall Agent brings overdue and dormant patients back, the Outbound Agent drives net-new demand and proves marketing ROI from first click to completed procedure, and the Care Management Agent runs billable care between visits with monthly check-ins and validated outcome surveys. White-labeled to each practice, HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II, AES-256.

Patient activation covers the places practices lose patients: website visitors who leave without booking, existing patients who go dormant in the EHR, net-new demand that never finds the practice, and care between visits that goes undelivered and unbilled. Clinekt is not a chatbot, not a contact form, not a voice answering service, and not reactivation software. Clinekt OS is the shared memory behind all four agents: every call, text, email, and visit lives in one memory, so patients never repeat their story and care stays continuous. The agents work alongside Epic, athenahealth, ModMed, NextGen, eClinicalWorks, and other major EHRs with no IT project. The Care Management Agent runs monthly check-ins and validated outcome surveys (HOOS Jr, KOOS Jr) on chronic and surgical patients, escalates concerns to practice staff, and documents the work so practices can bill Medicare care management through their normal billing process; the same engagement and matched outcome surveys prepare practices for CMS mandatory joint replacement bundle models.

Platform results: over 1 million patient interactions completed, 24x average ROI, +8% appointment volume, 48% reduction in unqualified consults. Website engagement runs 8-12% with the agent versus under 1% for static contact forms; 98% of website visitors normally leave without making contact. Example: Baldwin Bone and Joint, a multi-provider orthopedic group, generated 263 qualified surgical leads and 159 booked appointments with a 60% lead-to-appointment rate in a single quarter.

## Platform

- [What is AI patient activation?](https://clinekthealth.com/ai-patient-activation): the category definition, how it differs from patient engagement, reactivation and an AI receptionist
- [Platform overview](https://clinekthealth.com/platform): one platform, one brain, every patient activated; the patient journey and all four agents
- [Inbound Agent](https://clinekthealth.com/inbound-agent): answers every website visitor instantly, screens in about two minutes, books qualified patients around the clock
- [Recall Agent](https://clinekthealth.com/recall-agent): finds overdue and lapsed patients in practice records and books them back with real conversations by phone, text, and email
- [Outbound Agent](https://clinekthealth.com/outbound-agent): net-new patient demand with end-to-end attribution from ad click to completed procedure
- [Care Management Agent](https://clinekthealth.com/care-agent): billable between-visit care: monthly check-ins, outcome surveys, escalation, audit-ready documentation
